svg.aria-label: Shared memory banks touched by half a warp clearing face_b
svg.title: Shared memory banks touched by half a warp clearing face_b
svg.text: Shared memory banks hit by half a warp (4 groups × 4 lanes, one double each)
A double spans 2 of the 32 four-byte banks. Group g's slice starts at g × stride doubles.
stride 56 doubles (right for 8 lanes per element): groups 0 & 2 and 1 & 3 collide
stride 52 = 48 + LPE doubles: the 4 groups tile all 32 banks
